claim: Zod 4.6.7 never shipped following the repository compromise.
explanation: The project has an official 4.6.7 release published on October 12. Its 4.6.6 release notes also distinguish the repository incident from npm distribution: the six malicious commits were reverted and were never published to npm. This does not establish anything about a 4.6.8 release, nor does it make repository compromise equivalent to a malicious 4.6.6 npm artifact.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
